capabilities: Draw a daily question into your daily note from three choices or your own prompt
Generate follow-up questions from marked answers with an AI model
Turn any highlighted paragraph in your vault into a new question
Install and edit Markdown question banks with over 3,000 questions
Graduate a question thread from the daily note into a standalone piece
disambiguation: Not a text generator; it never writes your prose, only adds questions, frontmatter, and block ids.
extras: AI features need an OpenAI-compatible server, but bank-only mode works with no network call; the README states nothing written leaves the computer unless the endpoint is pointed elsewhere. Some topics (bank creation, model jobs) are covered in an external guide rather than the README.
motivation: A blank page stops you; a question doesn't.
problem: A blank daily note gives you nothing to react to, so journaling stalls; this adds a question to answer instead.

relations.evidence: The default expects one already running on your device. For Ollama:
finds Ollama or LM Studio on this device.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible server (e.g. Ollama or LM Studio)
API key, only if your server needs one

summary: Journaling prompt plugin that writes a question into your daily note and builds follow-up questions from the writing already in your vault.
